post_text:
Six new luxury hotels open in the Alps in December:

– Fouquet's Gstaad, by @Barrière, 4 December: 33 rooms, led by @Marie-Cécile Bouchet-Pichon, named General Manager of the hotel and chalet this month
– The First Cortina, Cortina d'Ampezzo, 4 December: 76 rooms and suites for @The Pavilions Hotels & Resorts, the group led by CEO @Florence Wong
– Bârma, Courchevel La Tania, 5 December: 75 rooms and suites, with a spa by Susanne Kaufmann
– Le Graal Cortina, from 8 December: 30 rooms, with cuisine by chef @Giovanni Guarneri
– Saint Roch, Courchevel 1850, 18 December: 37 keys for @Maisons Pariente, chaired by its co-founder @Leslie Kouhana, with a restaurant by Prunier
– Bourbon Hotel, Courchevel 1850, 18 December: 31 rooms, the first Courchevel address of @Chapitre Six, founded by @Nicolas Saltiel, with chef @Simone Zanoni at Simonetta

The signal: the Alps' newest luxury addresses are small, between 30 and 76 rooms. Family groups and independents, not only the big brands, are betting on short, high-yield winter seasons.

Which opening are you most curious about this winter?
